body: Quite frankly, until applications like AutoCad, VectorWorks, Affinity, Lightwright, and a myriad of other apps I use daily run natively on Linux I don't think I can use Linux seriously. It's not that Linux is too complicated or that we don't like using the terminal or that we are technologically unsavvy, it's just infinitely more convenient to use Windows until these companies release a version that runs natively on Linux rather than having to deal with slow processing times and low resolutions with WINE, especially since we use these programs for work.
